scope: Read the complete Japanese draft and all twelve complete translations. Compared metadata, title and description meaning, localized labels, Markdown formatting, placeholder code fence, external links, and draft status.
findings: The Japanese H1 contained a typo (プログタイトル); corrected it to ブログタイトル.

All thirteen editions contained duplicate date keys with conflicting values. Removed the accidental 2026-09-24 duplicate and retained the original 2022-01-01 date; recorded the review date in lastmod.
All translations preserve the same heading, lists, emphasis, table, links, quotation, horizontal rule, and two video URLs.
The fenced PowerShell block contains only a comment placeholder, so it is not presented as executable guidance.
This remains a draft and is not published by the production site.

post/000_テンプレート/index.ar.md.summary: Compared this complete localized template draft with Japanese: metadata, Markdown syntax examples, placeholders, links, and SEO-related description. Corrected the Japanese heading typo and removed the duplicate date field from all editions.

meaning.note: The title and localized descriptions identify this as a reusable article-writing template; examples and placeholders align with the Japanese draft.

terminology.note: Localized labels for headings, lists, code blocks, links, quotations, and SEO describe the same template elements.

mathematics.note: The template contains no mathematical claims or formulas.

code.note: The shell-fenced PowerShell placeholder is present in every edition; it is intentionally illustrative and is not an executable article example.

links.note: The Google link and two YouTube URLs match the Japanese template in all translations.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
This article is marked draft:true and is excluded from production publication.
